text:
Maria-CS: Quick heads-up — Lumenix QBR prep. Finance just flagged a ~3x token spike last week after they onboarded the new embed pipeline. Need a short runbook: spend forecast, throttle options, and a customer enablement ask.

Tyler-CSM: Noted. Are the spikes steady or a few jobs? I can reach out to the AE for context.

AJ-FinOps: Pulling the weekly run rate now. SQL to check top job types:```select job_type, sum(tokens) as tokens, count(*) as runs from usage where acct='lumenix' and ts > now() - interval '14 days' group by 1 order by tokens desc;```

billing-bot: Alert: Account lumenix exceeded 75% of monthly prepay on 2024-10-03. Link: https://billing.internal/redwood/accounts/lumenix/alerts

Kai-Sales: AE confirmed they flipped on an experimental batch embed job last Thursday — likely culprit. Customer expects high throughput for pilot next week.

Maria-CS: Ok. High-level plan: 1) short-term throttle/cap on parallel embeddings (CS + AE) 2) forecast next 30d at current and throttled rates 3) propose reserved capacity or credits if runway < 2 weeks 4) schedule enablement session to tune prompts/batch size.

AJ-FinOps: Forecast quick numbers: current 7-day avg = 460k tokens/day; if pilot continues at 3x peaks => ~1.4M tokens/day. Monthly cost delta ~ +$6.5k. If we cap concurrency to 30% of pilot, burns back to ~620k/day.

Tyler-CSM: Can we offer a temporary credit or retainer to buy runway while they optimize? What's the threshold for Sales approval? @Kai-Sales

Kai-Sales: We can authorize up to $3k one-off from the AE pool for strategic pilots. Anything above needs revenue commit + SDR review.

Maria-CS: Action items:
- Tyler-CSM: confirm pilot schedule w/ AE and customer (today)
- AJ-FinOps: prepare 2-scenario forecast table (current vs capped) + quick graf for QBR deck (by EOD)
- Kai-Sales: confirm if AE will accept a one-off $3k credit, otherwise outline commit ask
- Maria-CS: draft enablement agenda (prompt tuning, batching, cache tips)

AJ-FinOps: Will attach the forecast table here when done. Quick plan for forecast table columns: [scenario, daily_tokens, monthly_tokens, est_monthly_cost, runway_days].

Tyler-CSM: I'll ping the AE and update in-thread. If we cap concurrency, any infra ops needed?

Maria-CS: No infra change — we can implement request-side throttle via rate-limit policy for that API key + set alert at 90% prepay. AJ, can you add the emergency alert rule?

AJ-FinOps: Yep — will add alert: "lumenix_prepaid_usage >= 90%" with paging to oncall + CS. Also will add a temporary badge in the account dashboard.

Kai-Sales: If they accept the $3k credit, I'll log it in CRM and mark as "pilot support".

Tyler-CSM: AE replied — pilot runs Mon/Tue next week and they want full throughput. I'm proposing we run enablement Mon morning and cap for Tue to avoid overrun.

Maria-CS: Sounds good. I'll draft the QBR slide with proposed actions + numbers. AJ, can you attach the forecast by 5pm PT?

AJ-FinOps: On it. Will post the table and short notes in this thread. :white_check_mark:

Maria-CS: Thanks all. Keeping this thread as the single source for QBR action items and spend mitigation steps.

(reacts: :eyes: by Kai-Sales)
